subject.title: fix(signal): expose mention facts in inbound context

question: Should public inbound context keep `GroupRequireMention` as the canonical require-mention policy field, or should this PR intentionally add `RequireMention` as a second public name?
rationale: This is a public prompt/plugin context API choice with compatibility impact, and automation should not create or remove an alias without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep `GroupRequireMention` Canonical
options.body: Drop the new `RequireMention` field and add only the missing detection, any-mention, effective, and skip facts around the existing policy field.

options.title: Approve An Alias Contract
options.body: Keep `RequireMention` only with explicit docs/tests describing how it relates to `GroupRequireMention` and what consumers should prefer.

options.title: Pause Behind The Predecessor
options.body: Leave this draft parked until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/96738 lands or closes, then rebase and review the smaller unique context diff.

recommendation.title: Keep `GroupRequireMention` Canonical
recommendation.body: Drop the new `RequireMention` field and add only the missing detection, any-mention, effective, and skip facts around the existing policy field.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest routing candidate from current inbound context and mention-policy history.
